title: The Grinder (TV series)
premise_summary: The Grinder is an American legal sitcom television series created by Jarrad Paul and Andrew Mogel for Fox. The show was picked up to series on May 8, 2015, and aired from September 29, 2015 to May 10, 2016. On October 15, 2015, Fox ordered six additional scripts for the first season, potentially increasing the season order to 19 episodes. On October 27, 2015, Fox ordered a full season of 22 episodes for the first season.
